Refer & earn

Get paid for the businesses you already help

You probably already tell other shopkeepers what to use. Byapar eKhata pays you for it — a share of every subscription payment from every business you bring, for as long as they stay.

Get your referral linkBecome a marketer

How it works

Four steps, no forms to chase

01

Get your link

Every account has a personal referral link and QR code. Share it over WhatsApp, Viber, or print it and stick it on your counter.

02

They sign up free

The business you refer starts on the free plan, with no card and nothing to lose. You are credited the moment they register.

03

You earn on every payment

When they move to a paid plan you earn commission on each subscription payment they make — not a one-off bonus.

04

Withdraw your wallet

Commission lands in your wallet. Request a payout once you cross the threshold, and track the whole thing from your dashboard.

Marketer programme

For people who want more than a link

If you work with businesses every day — as an accountant, a computer shop, a consultant — the marketer programme gives you the tools to promote Byapar eKhata properly: your own code, a dashboard, performance tiers and faster payouts.

It is recurring income, not a bounty. As long as the businesses you brought keep paying, you keep earning.

Apply to be a marketerAsk a question

What you get

  • A dedicated referral code and link you can use anywhere
  • A dashboard showing sign-ups, active plans and commission earned
  • Wallet balance, payout requests and payout history in one place
  • Leaderboard standing so you know where you sit each month
  • Reusable campaign material for festivals and local events
  • Commission history per referral, per payment — nothing hidden

When commission is credited

Commission is credited to your wallet after the referred business's payment is settled and any refund window has passed. This keeps the balance honest for everyone.

How payouts work

Request a payout from your dashboard once your wallet crosses the minimum threshold. Payouts are made to a Nepali bank account or wallet, and every request is recorded.

Fair use

Self-referrals, duplicate accounts and fake businesses do not qualify. Accounts found gaming the programme are removed from it, and unpaid commission on those referrals is reversed.
